# Reptilians
Reptilians are a humanoid species, sporting tails and a pronounced snout. Their physiology has led them to adopt an accent similar to that of cobras.
## Unique Abilities
### Tail Dragging
- With their ability to manipulate their tails, Reptilians can drag objects with their tail, keeping both of their hands free.
## Diet
- They can eat raw meat and drink blood without any ill effects.
## Benefits
- They prefer a somewhat higher temperature range than humans, making them slightly less susceptible to higher temperatures.
- Their unarmed claw attacks deal [color=#ec3a3a]Slash[/color] damage instead of Blunt.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#ffa500]30% more Cold damage.[/color]
## Reptilian Naming Conventions
Reptilian names traditionally take the form of a short hyphenated phrase in their native language, typically related to their professions or interests. Some Reptilians may choose to translate this name into Common. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Kepanuu-Topith - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ja-Tasha - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ta-Zeen - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Protects-and-Serves - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Bites-Off-Faces - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Brain-Transplant-Successful - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Odds-and-Ends - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Bans-the-Admins - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Legally-Distinct-Godzilla - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Bowser Jr.
## Lore
Hailing from the planet Moghes, the Reptillian species, also known as the Unath, were the first which human's encountered in their transition to the stars. An important part of many of their cultures seems to be the process of hunting and gathering, which in recent is often expressed via frequent hunting trips to far off worlds.
